title: Implement idempotent terminal processing publication

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Terminal publication tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_terminal_publication.py

verify.summary: Compacted retained final functional PASS. Current task status is done.
Compacted final lifecycle closure: current task status is done.

evidence_required: FT-002-AC-002 RED: repeating or interrupting terminal delivery cannot yet converge on one final face/derivative set; GREEN: normal, repeat and post-derivative/pre-commit interruption all end with one terminal state, one stable face_index set and one deterministic preview/thumbnail pair; decisive comparison: rows, keys/checksums, timestamps and terminal no-op match the single-run baseline while dependency-owned private storage remains unexposed; artifact: fault timeline plus isolated PostgreSQL/MinIO projection.
purpose: Publish one complete terminal face/derivative result idempotently across the accepted private object and processing-owned database boundaries.
success_outcome: Normal, repeated and post-derivative/pre-commit interrupted delivery converge on one terminal state, one complete face set and one deterministic derivative pair.
anti_goals: Do not run an engine, claim work, add distributed transactions, partial ready state or another retry lifecycle.
Do not expose derivative keys/media or overwrite a terminal result with a later delivery.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
stop_conditions: Convergence would require a cross-store transaction emulator, object-version lifecycle or concurrent-worker fencing.
A complete face set and terminal state cannot publish within one owner transaction.

constraints: Use deterministic task-owned derivatives from TASK-021 and claimed rows from TASK-022.
Fault injection occurs after derivative publication and before terminal database commit in isolated disposable state.
Repeat and cleanup are safe and touch only the task-owned rows/object prefix.
invariants: ready publishes only with both derivatives and at least one complete dimension-valid face set.
no_faces publishes with neither faces nor derivative keys.
Terminal repeat is a no-op and never duplicates face_index rows.
verification_targets: Normal, repeat and injected post-derivative/pre-commit interruption compare database rows, object checksums and cleanup in disposable PostgreSQL/MinIO state.
